uvRule.front: u = x / scale + sheetX + 0.5, v = (y / scale + sheetY) / artHeightUnits, for a 3D vertex (x, y, z) (x = page x, y = height); z is ignored. Characters are the case scale = 1 (character-local x).

desert.depthProfile: front pieces: h(x, z) = top(x) * p(z); p rises with smoothstep from depthZ.front to depthZ.crestFrom, stays 1 to crestTo, then falls as 1 - t^2 to back (back slope steeper than 35 deg: hidden from the viewer). rocks: p = sqrt(clamp(min(z - back, front - z) / 0.012, 0, 1)). tents: A-frame, ridge along z, gable at depthZ.front faces +Z. The front orthographic silhouette of the 3D equals silhouette3D.
